name: Jason Agraz
office: Wrightwood Community Services District, Member, Board of Directors

items.text: Jason Agraz is a business owner in financial services and a candidate for the Wrightwood Community Services District Board of Directors. He says he wants the board to be functional, efficient, and representative, with a focus on keeping streets safe, supporting youth and seniors, and promoting a healthy economy while protecting the quality of small-town living.
